2608.24268.title: ROBE: Reversed-Order-Biased-Experts for Extracting Extreme Long-tail Events from Historical Texts
2608.24268.paper_summary: This paper proposes methods to extract over 50 types of events from a Dutch historical corpus spanning the 17th and 18th centuries. The methods we propose aim to tackle the impossible: extracting the long-tail of the long-tail. Historic data from before the 19th century is in itself a niche domain not covered in the pre-training of Large Language Models, and we aim to extract events only very scarcely annotated in the training data available for this domain. We propose creating expert classifiers for subgroups of the events present in the training data. We make these groupings based on similar frequency in the training data or on semantic relatedness. Experts trained on underrepresented events are assigned higher priority when predicting to avoid being dominated by frequency biases. We refer to this new way of combining classifiers, specifically tailored to protect the long-tail, as ROBE: Reversed-Order-Biased-Experts. We also propose a controlled method to create domain-specific synthetic data. Our two implementations of ROBE outperform a simple fine-tuned encoder model with a .10 increase in recall and a .16 increase in precision respectively. The best model achieves a .10 increase in f1 for a group of long-tail classes in our niche data set.
2608.24268.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文提出了從17世紀和18世紀的荷蘭歷史語料庫中提取超過50種類型事件的方法。<lb/>我們提出的方法旨在解決不可能的任務：提取長尾中的長尾。<lb/>19世紀之前的歷史數據本身就是一個在大型語言模型的預訓練中未涵蓋的利基領域，我們的目標是提取在該領域可用的訓練數據中僅有極少標註的事件。<lb/>我們建議為訓練數據中存在的事件子群體創建專家分類器。<lb/>我們根據訓練數據中的相似頻率或語義相關性來進行這些分組。<lb/>對於被低估的事件，經過訓練的專家在預測時被賦予更高的優先權，以避免受到頻率偏見的主導。<lb/>我們將這種新型的分類器組合方式稱為ROBE：反向順序偏見專家。<lb/>我們還提出了一種受控的方法來創建特定領域的合成數據。<lb/>我們的兩個ROBE實現超越了一個簡單的微調編碼器模型，分別在召回率上提高了0.10和在精確度上提高了0.16。<lb/>最佳模型在我們的利基數據集中的一組長尾類別上實現了0.10的f1提升。
